name: 和風
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); margin: 0 !important; }

.outer-frame { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 520px; height: 520px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #8b4513 0%, #a0522d 50%, #8b4513 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px #dcb464, 0 0 0 12px #8b4513, 0 0 60px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.3), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); pointer-events: none; }

.inner-decoration { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 500px; height: 500px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #dcb464; box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.3), 0 0 20px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.2); pointer-events: none; }
#roulette-svg-target { border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #2a1810 0%, #1a0f0a 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); }

.center-mon { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateZ(0); width: 120px; height: 120px; z-index: 999; -webkit-app-region: no-drag; pointer-events: auto !important; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s ease-out; will-change: transform; backface-visibility: hidden; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.4)); }

.mon-outer { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b4513, #a0522d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #dcb464, 0 0 30px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.5), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); pointer-events: none; }

.mon-inner { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 85%; height: 85%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #2a1810 0%, #1a0f0a 100%); border: 2px solid #dcb464; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); pointer-events: none; }
.mon-symbol { font-size: 48px; color: #dcb464; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.8); animation: mon-glow 3s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; }
.pointer { position: absolute; top: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 40px; height: 60px; z-index: 20; pointer-events: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); }

.pointer::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 30px; height: 45px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #c41e3a, #8a0a1f); clip-path: polygon(50% 100%, 100% 0%, 0% 0%); }

.pointer::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 24px; height: 24px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #ffd700, #dcb464, #8b4513); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); z-index: 2; border: 1px solid #ffd700; }
/* ▼▼▼ 修正: 位置を 600px に統一 ▼▼▼ */

#result { position: absolute !important; top: 600px !important; left: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; transform: none !important; text-align: center !important; font-size: 42px; font-weight: bold; color: #dcb464; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000, -2px -2px 0 #000, 0 0 10px #dcb464, 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); -webkit-text-stroke: 1px #000; font-family: 'Yu Mincho', serif; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 0; }

#legend-area { top: 600px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(40, 20, 10, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #dcb464 !important; color: #dcb464 !important; pointer-events: none; }
